name: Garden ReviewPacket Builder One Use

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/review-packet/GARDEN-CYCLE-9808F68B96C2B1AD7FA2
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/review-packet-builder-one-use.yml

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read
  issues: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Build canonical packet
        id: packet
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: python tools/evidence/build_review_packet_one_use.py

      - name: Persist governed evidence branch
        env:
          CYCLE_ID: GARDEN-CYCLE-9808F68B96C2B1AD7FA2
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "garden-evidence-bot"
          git config user.email "garden-evidence-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add "evidence/review-packets/$CYCLE_ID"
          git commit -m "Persist immutable GardenReviewPacket $CYCLE_ID [evidence-only]"
          git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"

      - name: Summary
        run: |
          {
            echo "### Garden ReviewPacket"
            echo "- CycleID: ${{ steps.packet.outputs.cycle_id }}"
            echo "- packet_hash: `${{ steps.packet.outputs.packet_hash }}`"
            echo "- completeness: **${{ steps.packet.outputs.completeness_status }}**"
            echo "- blockers: `${{ steps.packet.outputs.blocker_codes }}`"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
